args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was approved and verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
